footguns.rule: Never create a DB engine/connection pool against an Azure-hosted SQL/Postgres target without registering the Entra (Azure AD) token-refresh connection listener.
footguns.why: Without the listener, the pool is opened once with a token that later expires; reconnects then fail auth silently instead of picking up a fresh token. This was the root cause of a prior production incident, and it reappeared in a new code path because the catalogued fix existed but wasn't consulted at write-time.
